result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a duplicate restaurant card is displayed in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant card appears twice consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel with identical imagery, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90 delivery).
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the list of restaurants returned for the 'Fastest near you' section so each restaurant appears only once.
